question: Where’s the nearest golf course that lies north of Sense Fine Art, Menlo Park, CA?
sql: WITH ReferencePoint AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)) AS lat_centroid FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sense Fine Art%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Menlo Park%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), GolfCoursesNorth AS ( SELECT poi_name AS name, geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)) > (SELECT lat_centroid FROM ReferencePoint) UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, geometry AS geom FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)) > (SELECT lat_centroid FROM ReferencePoint) ) SELECT name FROM GolfCoursesNorth, ReferencePoint AS RP ORDER BY GolfCoursesNorth.geom <-> RP.geom LIMIT 1;
